title: Form of Settlement, Processing Time and Travel Credit Terms by Package Product
content:
The refunds and settlements office records, against each of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products, the form in which value is returned on a cancellation, the time an approved settlement takes, and the terms of the future travel credit the product produces.

| Product | Form value is returned in | Settlement takes this many business days | A future travel credit stays redeemable for this many calendar months | Credit may be redeemed by another traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | no value is returned | 0 | 0 | no |
| Flex Bundle Package | the original form of payment | 21 | 12 | no |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | a future travel credit voucher | 21 | 18 | yes |
| Escorted Tour Package | a future travel credit voucher | 28 | 18 | yes |
| Ocean Cruise Package | a future travel credit voucher | 35 | 24 | yes |
| Luxury Collection Package | the original form of payment | 14 | 24 | yes |

## Points of judgement on the columns

The form column carries one of three recorded values across the range: that no value is returned, that value is returned to the original form of payment, or that value is returned as a future travel credit voucher. A validity figure of 0 calendar months, as the Value Bundle Package records, is a term of no months at all; a processing figure of 0 business days stands beside it on the same product.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A voucher produced by a package booked under the Ocean Cruise Package carries an expiry 24 calendar months from the date it was issued, and the schedule records that it may be redeemed by another traveller. A voucher produced by a package booked under the Flex Bundle Package would carry an expiry 12 calendar months from issue, and the schedule records that it may not be redeemed by another traveller.
